exposure: irregular intake of a balanced diet
cohort: 1142 women delivering in four private hospitals and four public hospitals in the northern region of Bangladesh during January to March 2010
finding: Eight risk factors were independently associated with caesarean delivery: previous c-section, pregnancy-induced swollen of leg, prolonged labour, maternal education status, maternal age more than 25 years, low birth order, length of baby more than 45cm and irregular intake of a balanced diet.
